description: This file contains a Jetpack Compose UI implementation for a chat interface in an Android app. It includes UI composables for displaying chat messages, session selection, error messages, and user interactions such as sending messages and attaching images. The file also manages state using ViewModel and Kotlin coroutines for asynchronous operations.

classes.name: PendingImageAttachment
classes.description: Data class representing an image attachment pending upload, including its filename, MIME type, and base64-encoded content.

methods.name: resolvePendingAssistantAutoSend
methods.description: Determines if an automatic send prompt should occur based on the pending prompt, system health, and run count.

methods.name: dispatchPendingAssistantAutoSend
methods.description: Performs the dispatch of a pending prompt if conditions are met, using a suspend function callback.

methods.name: ChatSheetContent
methods.description: Main composable function rendering the chat interface with message list, session selector, input area, and error handling.

methods.name: ChatThreadSelector
methods.description: Composable for selecting different chat sessions, visually indicating the active session.

methods.name: ChatErrorRail
methods.description: Composable to display chat error messages with styled UI.
